# OpenMemory Guide — Ultraterrestrial Resurrection

## Overview

UAP research platform monorepo: Next.js app (&#96;apps/app&#96;), disconnected Python RAG (&#96;apps/disclosure-rag&#96;), Neon Postgres via &#96;@db/postgres&#96; (&#96;packages/db&#96;).

## Architecture

- Research canvas → MindMap shell → ViewSwitcher → Graph / Timeline / Sightings / Search / Detail
- Live AI: disclosure mindmap agent + Prometheus chat
- Design: Microfilm Dark (&#96;DESIGN.md&#96;), vision docs in &#96;docs/vision/&#96;

## User Defined Namespaces

- frontend
- design

## Components

### OraclePanel

- **Path:** &#96;apps/app/src/components/oracle-panel/&#96;
- **Purpose:** Oracle Recipe panel — view/edit multi-step workflow, confirm &amp; run, duplicate &amp; re-run
- **Stories:** &#96;Components/OraclePanel&#96; (incl. InteractiveDemo)
- **Deps:** framer-motion, @dnd-kit, lucide-react, sonner

### OryzaeTimeline

- **Path:** &#96;apps/app/src/components/oryzae-timeline/&#96;
- **Purpose:** Dark floating-card memory timeline (CodePen port) — spine, range nav, dimmed memories
- **Stories:** &#96;Components/OryzaeTimeline&#96;
- **Fonts:** Inter + Noto Serif JP (injected via &#96;useOryzaeFonts&#96;)

### Cursor Research Subagents

- **Path:** &#96;.cursor/agents/&#96;
- **Purpose:** 18 project-scoped research specialists generated from the canonical v2 agent definitions
- **Scope:** Development-time Cursor subagents only; they do not add runtime product agents
- **Safety:** Shared epistemic contract, role authority, logical tool/write boundaries, handoffs, and output contracts are embedded in every agent
- **Generator:** &#96;.cursor/generate-research-agents.mjs&#96;
- **Excluded:** Restricted &#96;DOTY_PATTERN&#96; adversarial profile

## Patterns

- Feature/component folders: kebab-case dir, PascalCase components, co-located &#96;.stories.tsx&#96;
- Storybook demos that need state live as &#96;*Demo.tsx&#96; harnesses next to the component
- Design ports keep inline styles when matching source fidelity; extract tokens to &#96;types&#96; / constants
- Cursor research agents are generated from canonical source definitions to prevent prompt drift; logical tools remain capability boundaries rather than claims of available runtime tools

import json, re
from pathlib import Path
out = Path('/tmp/rocket-telemetry-hud')

for p in sorted((out/'raw').glob('*.json')):

# Dump full content of big messages

# Also dump experimental_content
for d in msgs:
    exp = d.get('experimental_content')
    if exp:
        (out/f"exp-{d['id'][:8]}.json").write_text(json.dumps(exp, indent=2)[:5_000_000])

# Extract fenced code blocks and file annotations from all text
all_text = []
for d in msgs:
    all_text.append(d.get('content') or '')
    all_text.append(json.dumps(d.get('experimental_content') or ''))
blob = '\n'.join(all_text)

# Patterns: ```tsx file="..." or ```tsx path or <!-- file: -->
patterns = [
    re.compile(r'```(?:tsx|typescript|ts|jsx|css|json)?\s*(?:file=\"([^\"]+)\"|path=\"([^\"]+)\")?\n([\s\S]*?)```', re.M),
]
# Also v0 style: file path headers before fences
file_blocks = re.findall(r'(?:^|\n)(?:file:\s*|//\s*File:\s*|###\s*)?(/?(?:app|components)/[^\n`]+\.tsx)\n```(?:tsx|typescript|ts)?\n([\s\S]*?)```', blob)
print('file_blocks', len(file_blocks))
for path, code in file_blocks:
    print(' ', path, len(code))

fenced = list(patterns[0].finditer(blob))
print('fenced', len(fenced))
for m in fenced[:30]:
    path = m.group(1) or m.group(2) or ''
    code = m.group(3)
    print(' fence', path or '(no path)', len(code), code[:60].replace('\n',' '))

# Look for "files" arrays in experimental content
for d in msgs:
    exp = d.get('experimental_content')
    def find_files(o, path='$'):
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            if 'name' in o and ('content' in o or 'source' in o) and str(o.get('name','')).endswith(('.tsx','.ts','.css')):
                yield o
            for k,v in o.items():
                yield from find_files(v, path+'.'+k)
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            for i,v in enumerate(o):
                yield from find_files(v, f'{path}[{i}]')
    files = list(find_files(exp))
    print(d.get('id')[:8], 'embedded files', len(files))
    for f in files:
        c = f.get('content') or f.get('source') or ''
        print(' ', f.get('name'), len(c), repr(c[:40]))
        if c and c.strip() not in ('GENERATING',):
            name = f.get('name').lstrip('/')
            dest = out/'src'/name
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_text(c)

Use &#96;agent-browser open http://localhost:3000&#96; to navigate to it.\n2. **Understand the page**: &#96;agent-browser snapshot&#96; — returns an accessibility tree with element refs (@e1, @e2, …)\n3. **Interact** using refs from the snapshot: &#96;agent-browser click @e3&#96;, &#96;agent-browser fill @e5 \"text\"&#96;\n\n- Always snapshot before interacting (refs change between page states).\n\n4. **Verify**: &#96;agent-browser screenshot&#96; or &#96;agent-browser get text @e10&#96;\n\n## Commands\n\n### Navigate\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser open &lt;url&gt;                          # Go to URL\nagent-browser back                                # Go back in history\nagent-browser forward                             # Go forward in history\nagent-browser reload                              # Reload the page\nagent-browser close                               # Close browser\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Interact\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser click &lt;ref|selector&gt;                # Click (e.g., click @e3 or click \"button.submit\")\nagent-browser fill &lt;ref|selector&gt; &lt;text&gt;          # Clear + fill + blur (for form fields)\nagent-browser type &lt;ref|selector&gt; &lt;text&gt;          # Type without clearing (appends to existing)\nagent-browser press &lt;key&gt;                         # Keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+a, etc.\nagent-browser select &lt;ref|selector&gt; &lt;value&gt;       # Select dropdown option\nagent-browser hover &lt;ref|selector&gt;                # Hover\nagent-browser scroll &lt;dir&gt; [px]                   # Scroll up/down/left/right\nagent-browser drag &lt;src&gt; &lt;dst&gt;                    # Drag and drop\nagent-browser check &lt;ref|selector&gt;                # Check checkbox\nagent-browser uncheck &lt;ref|selector&gt;              # Uncheck checkbox\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Inspect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser snapshot                            # Accessibility tree with refs (primary tool for understanding pages)\nagent-browser screenshot [path]                   # Screenshot (--full for full page, --annotate for numbered labels)\nagent-browser get text &lt;ref|selector&gt;             # Text content of an element\nagent-browser get html &lt;ref|selector&gt;             # innerHTML\nagent-browser get value &lt;ref|selector&gt;            # Input value\nagent-browser get title                           # Page title\nagent-browser get url                             # Current URL\nagent-browser eval &lt;js&gt;                           # Run JavaScript\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Wait\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser wait &lt;selector&gt;                     # Wait for element to appear\nagent-browser wait &lt;ms&gt;                           # Wait for time\nagent-browser wait --text \"Welcome\"               # Wait for text on page\nagent-browser wait --url \"**/dashboard\"           # Wait for URL pattern\nagent-browser wait --load networkidle             # Wait for network idle\nagent-browser wait &lt;selector&gt; --state hidden      # Wait for element to disappear\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Cookies &amp; Storage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser cookies                             # Get all cookies\nagent-browser cookies set &lt;name&gt; &lt;value&gt;          # Set cookie\nagent-browser storage local &lt;key&gt;                 # Get localStorage value\nagent-browser storage local set &lt;key&gt; &lt;value&gt;     # Set localStorage value\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dialogs\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser dialog accept [text]                # Accept (alert/beforeunload auto-accepted by default)\nagent-browser dialog dismiss                      # Dismiss\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Viewport\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser set viewport &lt;w&gt; &lt;h&gt;                # Set viewport size\nagent-browser set device &lt;name&gt;                   # Emulate device (e.g., \"iPhone 14\")\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Semantic Locators\n\nFind elements by accessible properties and act in one command — useful when you know the label but not the ref:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nagent-browser find role button click --name \"Submit\"\nagent-browser find label \"Email\" fill \"test@example.com\"\nagent-browser find testid \"save-btn\" click\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Batch Execution\n\nRun multiple commands efficiently in a single invocation:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nagent-browser batch \"open https://example.com\" \"snapshot -i\" \"screenshot\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Sessions\n\nUse &#96;--session &lt;name&gt;&#96; for isolated browser contexts with their own cookies and storage. Useful for parallel testing or simulating multiple users.\n\n## Examples\n\n### Test a login flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nagent-browser open http://localhost:3000/login\nagent-browser snapshot\nagent-browser fill @e5 \"user@example.com\"\nagent-browser fill @e7 \"password123\"\nagent-browser click @e9\nagent-browser wait --url \"/dashboard\"\nagent-browser screenshot login-success.png\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Responsive screenshots\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nagent-browser open http://localhost:3000\nagent-browser set viewport 1920 1080\nagent-browser screenshot desktop.png\nagent-browser set viewport 375 667\nagent-browser screenshot mobile.png\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Fill and submit a form\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nagent-browser open http://localhost:3000/contact\nagent-browser snapshot\nagent-browser fill @e3 \"John Doe\"\nagent-browser fill @e5 \"john@example.com\"\nagent-browser fill @e7 \"Hello, this is my message\"\nagent-browser click @e9\nagent-browser wait \".success-message\"\nagent-browser screenshot form-submitted.png\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&lt;/content&gt;\n\nYou can use the Read tool to load more context from the reference files.\nUse the Move(operation=\"copy\") to copy any of the reference files to the working directory.\n\n&lt;reference-files&gt;\nuser_read_only_context/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md\n&lt;/reference-files&gt;"}],"type":"task-skill-v1","parts":[{"type":"executing-skill","skillName":"agent-browser"},{"type":"skill-result","skillName":"agent-browser","fileCount":1}]},{"type":"launch-tasks","tasks":[{"name":"Bash","taskNameActive":"Screenshotting # OpenMemory Guide — Ultraterrestrial Resurrection

## Overview

UAP research platform monorepo: Next.js app (&#96;apps/app&#96;), disconnected Python RAG (&#96;apps/disclosure-rag&#96;), Neon Postgres via &#96;@db/postgres&#96; (&#96;packages/db&#96;).

## Architecture

- Research canvas → MindMap shell → ViewSwitcher → Graph / Timeline / Sightings / Search / Detail
- Live AI: disclosure mindmap agent + Prometheus chat
- Design: Microfilm Dark (&#96;DESIGN.md&#96;), vision docs in &#96;docs/vision/&#96;

## User Defined Namespaces

- frontend
- design

## Components

### OraclePanel

- **Path:** &#96;apps/app/src/components/oracle-panel/&#96;
- **Purpose:** Oracle Recipe panel — view/edit multi-step workflow, confirm &amp; run, duplicate &amp; re-run
- **Stories:** &#96;Components/OraclePanel&#96; (incl. InteractiveDemo)
- **Deps:** framer-motion, @dnd-kit, lucide-react, sonner

### OryzaeTimeline

- **Path:** &#96;apps/app/src/components/oryzae-timeline/&#96;
- **Purpose:** Dark floating-card memory timeline (CodePen port) — spine, range nav, dimmed memories
- **Stories:** &#96;Components/OryzaeTimeline&#96;
- **Fonts:** Inter + Noto Serif JP (injected via &#96;useOryzaeFonts&#96;)

### LittleBook

- **Path:** &#96;apps/app/src/components/little-book/&#96;
- **Purpose:** Scroll-driven 3D book (jh3y ExPVzBY) — GSAP ScrollTrigger page flips
- **Stories:** &#96;Components/LittleBook&#96;
- **Deps:** gsap + ScrollTrigger

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The reference prototype includes a WeatheredClassifiedDocument variant. The target file is a simpler ClassifiedDocument with two cards. I'm beginning to plan the integration steps.

PhotoCaption will be self-contained with inline Tailwind styles for standalone use. ClassifiedDocument becomes a named export following folder conventions. Stories go under Documents/ClassifiedDocument. Exports and documentation follow. The caption sits inside the polaroid frame rather than overlaying it. Polaroid frames need simpler typography.

PhotoCaption will support both block and absolute positioning via optional className. The export follows Prettier conventions without semicolons or single quotes. A standard img tag handles external blob URLs instead of Next.js Image.

Subcomponents will be extracted lightly while preserving source fidelity. The Card import path is confirmed.</details></think>
